description:
PREVENTIVE MAINTENANCE SERVICE OF LOW VOLTAGE SWITCHGEAR FOR US EMBASSY NEPAL

LOCATION: CHANCERY COMPOUND, MAHARAJGUNJ, KATHMANDU

The U.S. Embassy in Kathmandu, Nepal requires professional services to perform preventive maintenance on facility electrical switchgear. The objective is to ensure all systems covered under this agreement are maintained in optimal operational condition and in accordance with manufacturer and U.S. Department of State standards.
